title: Bvlgari perfume: Man in Black, the Man Essence sets and Splendida compared
body:
Bvlgari perfume for men centres on Man in Black and the Man Essence family, which we stock as gift sets with a travel spray. For women, we have Splendida Tubereuse Mystique. Here is every Bvlgari fragrance in stock, what is in each one, and who it suits.

Bvlgari Man in Black

Bvlgari Man in Black Eau de Parfum (100ml) is warm and dark. Rum, spices and tobacco open it; leather sits at the heart, softened by tuberose and iris; and guaiac wood, benzoin and tonka bean give a smooth, rich finish. It suits evenings and the colder months.

The Bvlgari Man Essence gift sets

Each set holds a 100ml eau de parfum and a 15ml travel spray of the same scent.

  • Man Glacial Essence: juniper berries, ginger and geranium, then sandalwood, orris root and artemisia, over clearwood, cedar and musk. Cool, fresh and woody.
  • Man Terrae Essence: citron and calamansi, then vetiver and orris, over a terrae accord and styrax. Earthier and warmer than Glacial.

The Man Rain Essence and Man Wood Essence sets are sold out at the moment.

Glacial or Terrae? Choose Glacial for a crisp, cool scent for every day; choose Terrae for an earthy, resinous one.

Bvlgari for women: Splendida Tubereuse Mystique

Splendida Tubereuse Mystique Eau de Parfum (100ml) puts creamy tuberose at the centre. Blackcurrant and davana add a fruity lift at the top, and vanilla absolute and myrrh give it a warm, resinous depth. Rich and heady, it is an evening floral. Rose Goldea Blossom Delight and Omnia Amethyste are sold out at the moment.

Which Bvlgari perfume should you choose?

  • Warm, boozy and leathery: Man in Black.
  • Cool and fresh, with a travel spray: Man Glacial Essence.
  • Earthy and woody, with a travel spray: Man Terrae Essence.
  • A rich white floral for her: Splendida Tubereuse Mystique.

Other scents in a similar mood

These are different perfumes, not copies:

  • If you like Man in Black's leather and vanilla: Guerlain Habit Rouge Eau de Parfum (100ml), with citrus, then rose, cinnamon and patchouli, over leather, vanilla, amber and benzoin. More in our Guerlain perfume guide.
  • If you like its darker side: Chopard Black Incense Malaki (80ml), with incense and spices, oud and leather, over amber, woods and resins.
  • If you like the Essence sets' woods: Acqua di Parma Sandalo (20ml), with bergamot and citrus, cardamom and lavender, over sandalwood, amber and tonka bean.
  • If you like Splendida's tuberose: the Gucci Bloom Eau de Parfum Gift Set, built around jasmine, tuberose and Rangoon creeper.

Good to know

  • Buying for him? See aftershave gift sets for him and our perfume gift sets guide.
  • What the labels mean: read extrait vs eau de parfum.
  • Every bottle is 100% authentic and dispatched from the UK, with free UK delivery over £40.
